reviews.text:
The service was very reassuring.

Thank you so much! 😭 …

As others have mentioned, it's expensive at night, but!!! They confirm with you during the initial phone call and before the procedure, asking, "It's expensive, is that okay...?" They see my pet urgently at night, and above all, I'm happy to pay for my family's sake.

My cat started breathing through its mouth, so I went around 8 PM. I left around 10 PM. Now it's calm and purring. Thank you for the appropriate treatment and explanation.

The staff are efficient, and I could tell they treat dogs and cats with love. It's an emergency situation, so I don't think it's appropriate to expect hospitality.

My dog ​​accidentally ate some Shine Muscat grapes, and I frantically called in the middle of the night.
The person who answered the first time was incredibly kind and provided wonderful support, understanding my anxieties, for which I am deeply grateful.
However, when I called back to consider whether to come in person, I was shocked by the response of a different female staff member.
In my panic, I mistakenly said, "I want you to do a test," but she seized on that and aggressively questioned me, "What kind of test?" and dismissively stated, "Whether to do a test will be decided after a doctor's examination."
While it was my own carelessness, it was an urgent situation involving my dog's life, which is why I called in the middle of the night despite knowing how busy you must be. The first staff member was wonderful, so it was disappointing that the other staff member couldn't even understand the feelings of a pet owner in an emergency and responded in such a dismissive manner.
I would like to express my gratitude again to the kind person I spoke to first.

My three-month-old Chihuahua had swallowed a toy, so I took him to the vet.

It was my first time taking him to an emergency vet at night, and I was very anxious, but the veterinarian and staff were incredibly kind, and I felt completely at ease leaving him in their care.

The situation was resolved with vomiting, but I mentioned my concern about hypoglycemia because he was a picky eater. They offered to keep him overnight while monitoring his blood sugar levels. I was so relieved that they offered the safest option for my beloved dog.

I also expressed my regret, saying, "I had been so careful to prevent him from swallowing anything," and the doctor reassured me by saying, "Accidental ingestion is common until around two years old," and "Please bring him back if anything happens." Their kind words were very comforting.

The female staff member was also very kind to my dog ​​and even shared her own experience with a similar incident involving her own dog, which greatly eased my anxiety.


Not only was the examination and treatment thorough, but I was truly grateful that they also empathized with my anxieties as a pet owner.

Addendum:
Even if your regular veterinary clinic is not a partner hospital, they will issue a written document detailing the chief complaint and treatment.

This provides peace of mind in case you need to visit your regular veterinarian the following day or later.

My dog swallowed metal ball chain in the middle of the night and I called other emergency clinic, they all rejected, probably I could not speak  Japanese or it just seemed not emergency to them.
But this clinic, they are very happy to help even some staff doesn’t speak English but all staff and doctors were super kind and super willing to help. I feel really really thankful! 😭🙏

My beloved cat received care from you some time ago.

She was suddenly hospitalized, and although she fought bravely during her stay, her life became critical. We had to choose between keeping her hospitalized or taking her home.

Initially, I said, "Please let her stay hospitalized," but then I realized I wanted to spend her last moments with her at home, so I urgently requested to take her home. You responded immediately, even calling a taxi and lending us a carrier.

You were so kind and helpful when I called early in the morning; it was incredibly reassuring for me, as I was filled with anxiety.

My cat was eventually able to return home, and we were able to spend her final moments together.

I am truly grateful for your kind and prompt response to my urgent request.

I will never forget your efforts to save my cat's life and your support in allowing us to cherish those last moments.

Thank you so much.
The explanation was very thorough and easy to understand.

My friend's dog became ill, and all the nearby after-hours veterinary clinics were full and turned us away.
After doing some research, I found this clinic and called them. They asked, "Can you come right away?" so we headed over.
The kindness of the receptionist and all the staff calmed my friend down a bit.
The examination resulted in a "wait and see" decision, but their willingness to avoid unnecessary tests and clear explanations helped my friend feel at ease.
It's a shame it's not within easy reach for regular visits, but I would definitely recommend this clinic to my dog-owning friends.

My 13-year-old dog developed nystagmus, neck stiffness, and hind leg paralysis in the middle of the night. When I called, I received only negative responses, such as, "If surgery is scheduled, you'll have to go home. Our consultation fees are expensive, are you sure you want to proceed?"
I went to another emergency veterinary hospital.

I'm so glad I went there.
I was so grateful that you changed the arrangements on short notice.

I've used your services about three times now. Most recently, it was two years ago.

I wanted to express my gratitude, and I apologize for the delay of two years.

Around 10 PM, my cat developed a fever.

It was a very cold day with heavy snowfall. Because of the snow, and because my cat dislikes going outside, I felt sorry for her. I was debating whether to take her to our regular vet the next day. I couldn't even catch a taxi. I called and told them I was undecided, and the receptionist asked, "What would you like to do?" I replied, "I want to help." That's when I made up my mind. Once a cat catches a cold, depending on the bacteria, the virus can remain. My cat had rhinitis for a long time. The doctor was a very kind man who asked, "Did she have a cold when she was a kitten? That might be causing the problem." He gave her an appropriate diagnosis and treatment, her fever subsided, and he referred me to our regular vet. If I hadn't taken her to the vet that night, she might have died because she's a senior cat. Thank you to the receptionist who gave me the courage to go. I've been there about three times, and the service has been excellent every time. The prices are only slightly higher than during the daytime.

They were very kind and helpful, even though it was late at night.

Thank you.

My pet chihuahua ate some soil from a flowerpot and vomited repeatedly. He was trembling, so I called for advice and brought him in just in case.

They performed a physical examination and said there were no symptoms requiring immediate attention, but I should bring him back to the hospital tomorrow. They were very thorough and helpful.

Even though it was late at night, all the doctors were very kind and helpful, and I'm truly grateful.

Thank you.

For those considering visiting the hospital →
Phone calls before your visit are smooth. You'll be asked about the time and cause of the abnormality, how long it will take to get to the hospital, etc., so it's a good idea to take notes of your pet's condition in advance.
The cost is high because it's a nighttime emergency. It's reassuring to have insurance.

I came because my cat had accidentally swallowed something.
I was sad, scared, and anxious thinking about my beloved cat's suffering, but the phone receptionist accurately explained the necessary information (time of ingestion, how long it would take to get there, etc.), and I was able to come to the hospital right away.

Fortunately, I didn't have to wait too long and the vet examined my cat, and after inducing emesis, the swallowed food was successfully expelled.
We tried inducing emesis once, but it didn't come out, and we considered the possibility of endoscopic surgery, but they clearly explained the disadvantages and other options.

I'm so grateful that the hospital is open even at night, and that they provided appropriate treatment. I can't express enough how grateful I am! I'm so grateful to have such a hospital. Thank you so much.
